title: Time-Dynamic Food Web Modeling to Explore Environmental Drivers of Ecosystem Change on the Kerguelen Plateau
authors: Roshni C. Subramaniam; Jessica Melbourne-Thomas; Stuart P. Corney; Karen Alexander; Clara Péron; Philippe Ziegler; Kerrie M. Swadling
loadability_evidence: No native EwE model file was verified or loaded; paper availability does not establish complete reconstruction. No native model file verified. Authors explicitly withhold CPUE, catch and model-estimated biomass time series under confidentiality agreements; full dynamic reproduction is not established.
documentation_evidence: Open paper reports 28 groups and balanced parameters in Appendix Tables A1–A2. Fishery CPUE/catch/estimated biomass data are confidential, limiting full calibration reproduction. Methods identify 28 groups, balanced parameters Tables A1–A2 and time-series descriptions Table A3 in supplemental appendix. Figure 1 gives actual model rectangle.
notes: Published Figure 1 gives rectangular model domain. No native database verified. Baseline companion is Subramaniam et al. 2020, Exploring ecosystem structure and function of the northern Kerguelen Plateau using a mass-balanced food web model, doi:10.1016/j.dsr2.2020.104787. Supplement link is publisher landing section, not confirmed binary.
quality_rationale: Provisional screening score. A readable source is not evidence of a successfully reconstructed or load-tested Ecopath model. No native EwE model file was verified or loaded; paper availability does not establish complete reconstruction. No native model file verified. Authors explicitly withhold CPUE, catch and model-estimated biomass time series under confidentiality agreements; full dynamic reproduction is not established.
geometry_method: Approximate reported study bounds; not an author-supplied polygon
geometry_note: Author-reported rectangular model domain (Figure 1 and model-domain text); genuine domain envelope, not EEZ-specific coverage.
recommendation: Northern Kerguelen Plateau model contains Heard/McDonald and French Kerguelen waters; aggregate regional food web.
coverage_note: Northern Kerguelen Plateau model contains Heard/McDonald and French Kerguelen waters; aggregate regional food web.
